spec.entry: open of first session of each disjoint local-calendar block
spec.exit: close of tenth held session; no intraperiod stop or profit target
spec.adjustment: Yahoo quote OHLC: split-adjusted, not dividend-adjusted; price-only ranking and technical levels
spec.tax_convention: current issuer purchase tax applied to every historical episode; not actual historical tax
spec.ranking: descending mean price return after modeled costs, among eligible current uptrend candidates; p*gain displayed alongside losses
spec.conditional_cohort: entry previous price close above its SMA200; non-overlapping blocks, dependence addressed by block bootstrap
limitations: current holdings selection and survivorship bias
ranking across many names creates selection bias
bootstrap intervals are pointwise, not simultaneous
before personal taxation and dividend purification
